end.summary:
Discussed how family members care for one another through household tasks.
Trisha named bringing water, a blanket, medicine, food, and packing a bag as caring tasks.
Trisha repeatedly said children are too small to help and that only adults should manage family care.
Trisha did not give an unaided explanation of why sharing household work matters.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying household tasks that help family members, including bringing water, a blanket, food, or medicine. Trisha gave several examples, but the mix-up that children are too small to help was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, invite Trisha to choose one safe, small task and talk about how sharing it helps the family.
